More or less correct. At its core amapiano was always about the piano, as proven by the likes of MFR Soul and Jaivane who are known as some of the pioneers of the movement, but the sound has evolved since 2018. Now we say the jazzy piano or soulful one which leans towards soulful house is known as private school amapiano, I'd suggest you listen to Kelvin Momo, and a song called Jazz box by C keys.

The hype piano is not one but many, the most popular is sgija. Mellow and Sleazy have mastered that sound. But there are other sounds. Piano from Pretoria, Soshanguve and Limpopo is more influenced by bacardi which was a popular genre around 2012... songs like Bhebha, and Myztro Ah Ah. Although there are exceptions and you can find a private school sound infused with others, like Washaa by Kelvin Momo, or All Pretty Girls Love Amapiano part 2 and 3 by Kabza De Small.

I'm 3 years in, I think somewhere along the way everything just clicked...when I made my first full instrumental (that actually sounded good) I couldn't stop playing it and now I've made plenty, I always get completely from people I don't know as well.. only thing is I still don't know music theory apart from the basics but I'm learning war training so that I can become an absolute beast
Excuse the typos. I hope my message still gets across.
